scope: 17 connected paths across five depth lenses; selected source/data declarations, not whole game/native runtime semantic coverage.

findings.claim: Generation has explicit phases and historical source provenance, rather than one undifferentiated random-content call.

chain.prerequisites: Native supplies random_object_parameters and world tables.
chain.decision: pre_gen_randoms/main_world_randoms choose early/prehistory hooks.
chain.cost_time: No measured worldgen duration; hooks can run on multiple generate calls.
chain.mutation: Materials, items, languages, creatures, interactions and entities register in order; GENERATED and source HF/entity IDs accompany generated definitions.
chain.downstream: Later raw references connect the output objects to their origin.
chain.failure_aftermath: The file warns that repeated generate calls are not predictable; a mod must not assume one invocation.

findings.qualification: Generator implementation inspected; native callers, serialization and historical consumers unrecovered.

findings.claim: Candidate generation sorts keys for RNG stability, discards nil results, then weights the remaining candidates.

chain.prerequisites: A registered generator table and native trandom.
chain.decision: Each candidate returns an eligible weighted result or nil.
chain.cost_time: All registered generators are evaluated before selection; RNG is consumed during evaluation as well as selection.
chain.mutation: Selection subtracts weights from a roll; final fallback is first result or nil.
chain.downstream: Selected tables become registered definitions in generate_random_* consumers.
chain.failure_aftermath: Empty candidate sets/fallbacks differ from guaranteed content; missing weights are diagnosed but final v.weight use remains an assumption.

findings.qualification: Stable key ordering is source-verified; deterministic full worlds and RNG persistence are untested.

findings.claim: Generated creatures are filtered by habitat, humanoid suitability, good-alignment compatibility and beast constraints before profile selection.

chain.prerequisites: Source options supply water/humanoid/good/beast constraints.
chain.decision: Profile candidates are filtered and weighted, with GENERAL_BLOB fallback.
chain.cost_time: No native performance or combat cost measured.
chain.mutation: Selected profile contributes body construction, description and graphics through separate builders.
chain.downstream: Body, visible warning and graphical depiction share one selected profile.
chain.failure_aftermath: Unavailable candidates fall back to a blob; a name alone does not establish a functional body.

findings.qualification: Selected filter/entry/builder joins inspected; the large profile/body/graphics tables remain mostly unread.

findings.claim: Guardian equipment uses a separate entity-driven generation path even though generate_random_items is a TODO.

chain.prerequisites: Guardian generation parameters and angel item generators.
chain.decision: Generate item definitions first, then attach their tokens to the guardian entity.
chain.cost_time: No material production cost is specified in this worldgen path.
chain.mutation: raws.register_items precedes entity token insertion and divine material equipment flags.
chain.downstream: Guardian society equipment refers to generated item IDs, not only flavor names.
chain.failure_aftermath: Mythical guardians choose only non-generated existing item definitions; native equipment issuance is not inspected.

findings.qualification: Registration/selection source inspected; no claim that the TODO means all item generation is absent.

findings.claim: Material sale value, allowable item uses, density, thermal limits and mechanical responses are distinct properties.

chain.prerequisites: Material definition plus item definition.
chain.decision: Iron is permitted for weapon/armor uses; higher-value gold has different mechanical properties and use tags.
chain.cost_time: Weapon size/material-size and required body size are declared separately.
chain.mutation: Weapon modes specify contact, penetration, velocity and recovery, while materials supply yield/fracture/strain.
chain.downstream: Crafting eligibility and combat inputs can differ from appraisal value.
chain.failure_aftermath: Native crafting and collision equations remain unrecovered; no best-weapon balance claim.

findings.qualification: Definition inputs and joined consumers inspected; actual material combat formulas unavailable.

findings.claim: Steel production separates intermediate pig iron, flux, coal reagent and the general fuel requirement.

chain.prerequisites: Civilization permits reactions, smelter exists, matching reagents are available.
chain.decision: Use ore or bars for alloy routes, or build the pig-iron-to-steel chain.
chain.cost_time: Pig iron declares iron+flux+coal and FUEL; steel declares iron+pig iron+flux+coal and FUEL.
chain.mutation: Products are real bars with quantity/dimension, not an abstract metallurgy level.
chain.downstream: Material outputs feed permitted equipment/material consumers.
chain.failure_aftermath: FUEL is not interchangeable with the listed coal reagent; native magma exceptions and work-order reservations are not inspected.

findings.qualification: Native interpreter/execution not observed; no gameplay launch.

findings.claim: Reaction inputs distinguish consumed material from preserved containers and tools that do not scale product amounts.

chain.prerequisites: Matching material, suitable empty/containing container, correct workshop.
chain.decision: Choose tallow/oil soap or a drink recipe with real container support.
chain.cost_time: Raw amounts and PRODUCT_DIMENSION are separate; PRESERVE_REAGENT containers are retained.
chain.mutation: Output is routed into the actual container where declared.
chain.downstream: Durable carriers can support another batch while material stock decreases.
chain.failure_aftermath: Full, wrong or rotten inputs fail declaration filters; cancellation/refund transaction timing is native/unrecovered.

findings.qualification: Native interpreter/execution not observed; no gameplay launch.

findings.claim: Species/material reaction products preserve provenance through tanning, fat rendering, drink brewing and paper processing.

chain.prerequisites: Reagent has the required reaction-product mapping and is unrotten where required.
chain.decision: Pick a usable material route instead of treating every plant/body component alike.
chain.cost_time: Recipe amount and facility/skill apply.
chain.mutation: GET_MATERIAL_FROM_REAGENT selects the source-specific material or mapped result.
chain.downstream: Output can retain species-specific drink/thread/paper identity.
chain.failure_aftermath: A named reagent without the required material mapping does not qualify; native stack allocation not recovered.

findings.qualification: Native interpreter/execution not observed; no gameplay launch.

findings.claim: Glazing improves the existing empty, unimproved object while preserving that reagent.

chain.prerequisites: Glaze material mapping, CAN_GLAZE object, empty and NOT_IMPROVED.
chain.decision: Use a surface treatment on an actual jug/statue.
chain.cost_time: Glaze input and FUEL; object has PRESERVE_REAGENT.
chain.mutation: IMPROVEMENT adds material-specific glaze to the retained object.
chain.downstream: Object identity and original work survive the new treatment.
chain.failure_aftermath: Existing improvements/contents affect eligibility; not a duplicate-object reward.

findings.qualification: Native interpreter/execution not observed; no gameplay launch.

findings.claim: Workshops couple construction inputs, labor, work position and recipe role; appearance does not establish universal facility support.

chain.prerequisites: Build labor/materials and facility access.
chain.decision: Construct soap workshop or screw press according to the required function.
chain.cost_time: Soap workshop consumes bucket/build material; screw press requires two trap parts.
chain.mutation: Definitions set work tile and build labor; recipes name compatible buildings.
chain.downstream: A press processes liquids/paper only through appropriate upstream preparation and containers.
chain.failure_aftermath: Native pathing/occupancy/worker scheduling remain unavailable; facility ownership is not inferred.

chain.decision: Acquire knowledge and then invoke a particular granted interaction.
chain.cost_time: Declared range and WAIT_PERIOD apply to use; research/book-learning costs are native/unrecovered.

larger_original_implications.analysis: A faculty, tissue/material, reach, timing, learned method and current source support can all change execution. Keep the learned knowledge when a body is unsuitable. Finite functional injuries fit YAIR before a full anatomy simulation.

larger_original_implications.theme: Production is a graph of competing uses
larger_original_implications.analysis: One plant or material may have several outputs and an identity-preserving treatment. Use actual native items, preserved tools, source-specific conversions and useful byproducts. Existing finite reserves should choose a recipe before committing stock.

larger_original_implications.theme: Information is paid work with provenance
larger_original_implications.analysis: Physical records, qualified observers and offices can improve knowledge precision without omniscience. A current stock report should be a sampled estimate or actual counted receipt, not a second inventory. Teaching can change capability only after an eligible learner performs the work.

Culture permissions, appointment, succession, policy, personal belief and worker willingness differ. A school or guild can change what its own officer offers with actual facility/funding and a meaningful refusal; membership is not mind control.

Production, extraction and wealth can alter which inhabitants notice a site. Tie finite threats to visible world changes and actual informed actors, with practical responses and retained aftermath, rather than secretly scaling every opponent to the player.

A curse, interrupted visit or changed body should retain origin and target identity, distinguish treatment from complete removal, and change only its supported clocks. Specific culpability/observer records prevent generic retaliation at everyone.

larger_original_implications.theme: Content pins are part of persistence
larger_original_implications.analysis: A save depends on body/action/material definitions and compatible revisions. YAIR already validates exact frozen jobs; new content should keep old meanings and migrations. Snapshotting inputs is retention, not proof that new gameplay saves work.

larger_original_implications.theme: Graphics uses rules rather than replacing them
larger_original_implications.analysis: Keep body/state, discoverable description and rendering distinct. A later visual workshop should present the same work tile, rights, custody, interrupted work and produced identity. This report selects no replacement engine and copies no art.

runtime_qualifier: Every gameplay effect is source-inspected/generated/declarative or documented, runtime-unverified. No whole-game source recovery claim.
